name: KASH
description: Batched ETH/wBTC yield on Arbitrum One. Delta-neutral funding-rate arbitrage — agents mint, verify, and redeem directly from the vault contracts with no UI required.

nav.note: Published NAV = last updateNAV write. A live rebuild can differ until the next write. Prices are 18-decimal USD.

batch.minDeposit: ~$10 USDC (mint skip threshold, not an on-chain floor)

flow.mint: submit ETH/wBTC -> batched daily -> claim KASH after batch
flow.redeem: submit KASH -> batched daily -> claim ETH/wBTC
flow.cycleRule: deposit N redeems in cycle N+1

integrationNotes: The vault token getter is kashTokenEth()/kashTokenBtc(), NOT the standard ERC-4626 token(). A generic ERC-4626 reader will revert.
Never skip isUserWindow() or paused() before submitting a mint/redeem.
Do not treat indicative PA yield on the site as a promise — it is a forward estimate.
Not financial advice. Smart-contract, market, and counterparty risk apply. DYOR.
